verdict.rationale: PayPal's own Subscriptions docs cover the core of the story: fixed or per-seat plans, free or discounted trials, upgrading or downgrading plans, and automated failed-payment recovery. The agent toolkit also documents create/update/cancel subscription and plan tools, and the REST API lists subscriptions among its resources. Missing for 10: any evidence of proration handling on plan changes, in-depth API-level detail on upgrade mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
